description.text: Time of Application The College enrolls students at both spring and fall semesters, in February and September. Students may apply at anytime of the year. School System Long-term Chinese language classes includes: elementary classes (I, II); intermediate classes (I, II); advanced classes (I, II), each lasting one year. Fees 1. Tuition fee: CNY 8,800/student/semester (including teaching materials) 2. Application payment: USD 50/student 3. Boarding cost: CNY 6,800/student/semester (double SR);CNY 14,640/student/semester (one room) 4. Deposit: CNY 800/student (will be returned when the student leaves) 5. Insurance: CNY 90/student/year 6. Rates for food: not included Curriculum and Purposes of this Program Grade Curriculum Purposes of this Program Elementary Class Intensive Reading in Chinese, Extensive Reading in Chinese, Chinese Speaking and Listening Comprehension, Writing of Chinese Characters Students will master 2,410 common Chinese words and 185 basic Chinese grammar items. Students will carry on simple conversations, reading and writing in Chinese Intermediate Class Modern Chinese, intermediate Chinese Speaking and Listening Comprehension, Extensive Reading, Commercial Chinese, Chinese Composition, Reading of Selected Newspaper and Magazine Articles Students will master 2,850 Chinese words and 80 Chinese grammar items of intermediate level. Students have basic communication ability and may use Chinese in their routine study and life Advanced Class Modern Chinese, Advanced Chinese Composition, Reading of Selected Newspaper and Magazine Articles, Advanced Cultural Knowledge. Advanced Commercial Chinese, Chinese Grammar Students will master about 2,800 Chinese words and about 100 Chinese grammar items of advanced level. Students will have higher communication ability and a better understanding of Chinese culture. Specialized courses Chinese Painting, Chinese calligraphy, Wu Shu (Chinese Martial Arts), Chinese Music and Dance, Chinese Language Computer Programs, HSK classes, etc To learn Chinese culture and understand the spirit of Chinese history Long-term Chinese language classes have 14 Chinese professional courses and the school hours are above 800 hours each year. There are also several elective courses for Chinese culture

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language Classes at Beijing Chinese Language and Culture College is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate of senior high school graduation or equivalent schooling Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants should be overseas Chinese and foreigners of Chinese origin. 2.High school graduate or equivalent or above. 3.Be in good health 4.Record of good conduct
